{{Top|leg}}
[[File:Unknownswoopbiker.png|thumb|250px|[[Unidentified swoop biker|A swoop biker]] wearing a shock-helmet]]
'''Shock-helmets''' were headgear worn by some [[Swooper/Legends|swoop drivers]]. Many members of [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gangs]] on Tatooine wore tall shock-helmets.<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Swoop Mercenary}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Swoop_biker_SW4_Special_Edition.jpg|250px|thumb|Concept art of the rider]]
The [[Unidentified swoop biker|swoop biker]] wearing this helmet could first be glimpsed briefly in the [[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|Special Edition]] of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. Concept art of this biker drawn by [[TyRuben Ellingson]]<ref name="SE Widevision 31">{{Topps|set=1997 Topps Star Wars Special Edition Widevision|cardname=#31 Int. Mos Eisley&mdash;Spaceport&mdash;Docking Bay 94|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/73004/cid/5259678/1997-Topps-Star-Wars-Special-Edition-Widevision-Hobby-14-Rearing-Ronto}}</ref> showed a complete detailed view of the character and his helmet. Another piece shows two riders instead of one, both wearing similar outfits.<ref name="6 Fascinating">{{SW|url=news/6-fascinating-behind-the-scenes-concepts-from-the-star-wars-trilogy-special-edition|text=6 Fascinating Behind-the-Scenes Concepts from The ''Star Wars'' Trilogy Special Edition|nolive=1}}</ref> The helmet was later named in the [[Special Edition Limited]] set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]].<ref name="CCG" />
